rotation_warning: Rotate “{name}”? First let uploads catch up while the old token is valid, then stop every affected collector. Confirmation invalidates the old token immediately. Shutdown preserves pending uploads; it does not drain them to the server. Save the replacement token, update its private file, and restart with a new private queue directory. Retain the old queue; it cannot be reused with the replacement token.
revocation_warning: Revoke “{name}”? This permanently invalidates its token and stops new submissions from collectors using it.
recorded_interval: Recorded interval: {from} – {to} UTC (end exclusive). These charts do not establish workload membership or execution resource consumption.
chart_caption: {label}. Bucket start in UTC and last recorded sample in {unit}.
chart_context: These are the selected source’s node measurements during the recorded interval, not proved workload consumption. CPU is cumulative across logical CPUs, not utilization. Memory is node-wide. Each continuity segment keeps its last sample in a {duration} bucket; missing samples stay empty. Buckets use source timestamps without clock correction. Restarts and counter resets remain separate segments within each logical chart; they are never summed or connected.
setup_build: On Linux, build from this repository with its pinned Rust toolchain. Create {directory} first if needed.
setup_no_trace: Do not paste the token into a command, URL, ticket, or environment variable. Do not enable shell tracing ({command}). Clear your clipboard after saving it.
setup_endpoint: The endpoint is the ingestion service’s OTLP/gRPC address, not this web app. The current collector supports HTTP only: use loopback or a trusted private network/tunnel, never the public Internet. Keep {visibility} visibility unless deployment has verified access to initial host PIDs.
setup_drain: Stop every affected collector with SIGINT or SIGTERM while the old token is still valid. With the unchanged token, endpoint and queue settings, run {command} to export pending uploads without sampling. Inspect rejection and loss diagnostics: an empty queue alone does not prove every batch was accepted.
setup_environment: Environment equivalents: {endpoint}, {token} (file path only), {host}, {namespace}, {visibility}, and {queue}. The token file is read at startup. After rotation, replace it and restart every affected collector with a new private queue directory. Retain the old queue for investigation; the collector refuses to reuse it with the replacement token.
host_policy_help: Exact IDs only, up to 256; no wildcard matching. Use the collector’s explicit {flag} or its default Linux {path}. Every provided host ID must be on this list, even when identification is optional.
